attributes.name: Kyzyl-Tas Mine
attributes.description: Fictional open-pit Cu-Au(-Mo) mine, parametrised from public Bozshakol/Aktogay (KAZ Minerals) data. Not a real company.

attributes.name: Main Pit
attributes.description: Single open pit, twin geometry 3.0 km x 1.8 km, bench height 15 m, ramp grade 8% design / 10% max.

attributes.name: Fleet Dispatch
attributes.description: Logical fleet-management node (modelled on KAZ Minerals' Leica/Hexagon Jigsaw dispatch at Bozshakol/Aktogay): groups haul trucks, shovels and drills, and carries fleet-level KPIs.

attributes.name: Concentrator Plant
attributes.description: Groups the crusher, conveyors, SAG/ball mills, flotation bank, tailings facility and process stockpiles; carries plant-level KPIs.

attributes.name: Main Substation
attributes.description: 220 kV intake, sized on Bozshakol's reported 214 MW project power requirement fed from Ekibastuz GRES-1.

attributes.name: Site Weather Station
attributes.description: Kazakh steppe climate station near the pit rim; coordinates approximate Bozshakol (50.2N, 74.4E).

attributes.name: Scenario Control
attributes.description: Shared what-if control twin. Written by the UI (PATCH), read and reset by the simulation engine. Undo writes every field back to its default.

attributes.name: Mine KPI Roll-up
attributes.description: Mine-wide KPI snapshot per the revenue-per-hour model in 03_domain.md section 9.3 (base case: TPH 3600, f 0.50% Cu, R 80%, Cu $14,500/t, Au $4,300/oz).

properties.value: [t=  0.62h] shovel-s4: unplanned failure (wear-out, missed by inspection), MTTR 5.7 h
